photos.desc: Leaves finely cut into lacy segments,flowers white,pink,rose with yellow center.
Cosmos bipinnatus , flowerheads; roadside weed, between Dominionville and Hartbeesfontein, North West, South Africa
From my wife's garden, grown from seed. First flower opened this morning.
These delicate, wild Cosmo flowers just flourish in the driest conditions.
